title: 駅のアナウンス
lines: Attention, please. The 8:15 train to Oxford is running about 20 minutes late.
It will now leave from platform 4 instead of platform 2.
Passengers for Reading should change at the next station.
We're sorry for the delay and thank you for your patience.

questions.q: オックスフォード行きの電車はどうなっている？

questions.explain: leave from platform 4 instead of platform 2

title: 新しい職場の初日
lines: Hi, you must be Tom. I'm Lisa, your manager.
Nice to meet you, Lisa. I'm a bit nervous, to be honest.
Don't worry. Everyone feels that way on their first day.
This morning, you'll get your laptop and meet the team.
After lunch, Kevin will show you how our system works.
Great. Should I ask Kevin if I have any questions?
Yes, or you can always come to me.

questions.q: Tom は午前中に何をする？
choices: システムの説明を受ける
パソコンを受け取りチームに会う
questions.explain: you'll get your laptop and meet the team
I'm a bit nervous と言っています。

title: 診察を受ける
lines: So, what seems to be the problem?
I've had a sore throat and a headache since Monday.
A little, last night. I couldn't sleep very well.
It looks like a cold. Get plenty of rest and drink lots of water.
If you don't feel better in 3 days, come back and see me.

choices: 休んで水分をとり、3日で治らなければ再診
questions.explain: plenty of rest, lots of water, come back in 3 days if not better.

title: レストランの予約
lines: Good evening, Rossi's. How can I help you?
Hi, I'd like to book a table for 6 people this Friday.
I'm afraid we're full at 7:30. Would 8 o'clock be OK?
Yes, that works. Could we have a table by the window?
I'll make a note of that.

questions.explain: 7:30 は満席で 8 o'clock になりました。

title: 荷物が届かない
lines: Excuse me, my suitcase didn't come out on the belt.
I'm sorry about that. Which flight were you on?
It's a large blue suitcase with a yellow tag on the handle.
OK. We'll deliver it to your hotel as soon as we find it.

questions.q: スーツケースの特徴は？
choices: 大きな青いスーツケースに黄色いタグ
questions.explain: a large blue suitcase with a yellow tag

questions.q: 見つかったらどうなる？
choices: シカゴへ送り返される
questions.explain: We'll deliver it to your hotel

title: ジムの入会
lines: I'm thinking about joining the gym. How much is a membership?
It's 40 dollars a month, or 400 dollars for the whole year.
Does that include the swimming pool?
Yes, and you can join any of our yoga classes for free.
Sounds good. Can I have a look around first?

questions.explain: Can I have a look around first? → Follow me.

title: ルームメイトとの予定
lines: Are you gonna be home tonight?
Probably not. I've got a study group until 9.
OK. I was gonna cook pasta. Do you want me to save you some?
That'd be great, thanks. I'll eat it when I get back.
Also, don't forget it's your turn to take out the trash.
Oh, right. I'll do it before I leave.

questions.q: B が今夜遅くなる理由は？
questions.explain: I've got a study group until 9.

questions.q: B が出かける前にすることは？
questions.explain: take out the trash → I'll do it before I leave.

title: 留守番電話のメッセージ
lines: Hi Sarah, it's Mike. I'm calling about the concert on Saturday.
I managed to get 2 tickets, but they're for the late show at 9.
Let's meet at the café across from the theater at 8.
If that doesn't work for you, just send me a text.

questions.q: コンサートの開始時間は？

questions.explain: the café across from the theater

title: 美術館ツアーの案内
lines: Welcome to the City Art Museum. My name is Anna, and I'll be your guide today.
The tour takes about one hour.
We'll start on the ground floor with modern paintings.
Please don't touch any of the artwork, and photos without flash are fine.
At the end, there's a gift shop where you can buy postcards.

questions.q: 写真撮影について正しいのは？
